sloka: तम् अतिक्रम्य शैलेन्द्रम् महेन्द्र परिपालितम् ।षष्टिम् गिरि सहस्राणि कांचनानि गमिष्यथ ॥४-४२-३६॥
transliteration: tam atikramya śailendram mahendra paripālitam ।ṣaṣṭim giri sahasrāṇi kāṁcanāni gamiṣyatha ॥4-42-36॥

translations.english: 'On crossing the hill ruled by Indra you will reach the rows of sixty thousand mountains of gold shining like the brilliance of the rising Sun. The mountains glow with golden trees filled with bloom.
